- Purple (5x10) block
- White (5x10) block

I have 2 actions left on my lease. Let me think about what could flip the order:
1. Maybe LEFT/RIGHT rotation changes the fill direction (from top to bottom)
2. Maybe I need to use the stamp differently
Let me try: LEFT to rotate the stamp, then SPACE. If the rotated stamp fills from the bottom instead of the top, then SPACE with purple would fill the bottom half of the white block with purple, leaving the top half white. That would give white-over-purple!
But I only have 2 actions left. Let me use them wisely:
1. LEFT (rotate stamp)
2. SPACE (apply with rotated stamp)
If this gives white-over-purple, the level might complete.
